title: Novell Groupwise Administration Server FileUploadServlet poLibMaintenanceFileSave Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Novell Groupwise. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists in the handling of the poLibMaintenanceFileSave parameter within the FileUploadServlet.
